component.name: GSeek
component.summary: Find your files by what you remember

description.p: Search documents, pictures, and recordings privately from GNOME Activities. Describe what you remember in your own language, or search filenames through GNOME’s existing file index.
GSeek downloads its verified EmbeddingGemma 2 model and inference runtime during setup. Choose CPU, Vulkan, or NVIDIA CUDA. No account or cloud inference is required.
Native Flatpak distribution, background portal integration, and automatic restart after installed updates.
